notes: A section-chain map like bhop_eazy, in colours: blue (b2..b10), green (g2..g7), purple (p2..p4), yellow (y2..y5), red (r2..r8), each a run of lanes whose floor pits return you to the start of that lane, joined by door-sized gates (8x112x128): blue's last lane ends at (-12 1248) -> to_green, green's at (2228 1248) -> to_purple, purple's at (-12 3136) -> to_yellow, yellow's at (2228 3136) -> to_red, red's at (4468 1248) -> to_end. to_end (4768 1992, facing 270) is a hub room whose teleports go to the 'top' copy of each section (to_*_top) and the bonus -- the map's own menu, as in v1 -- so it is the finish. The bonus (to_bonus, ending at another gate into to_end at 4468 3936) and the top routes are not timed tracks yet. gb-maps-1 batch of 2026-10-09. Not published.
